name: sex
question: Respondent's sex

name: registered
question: Some people are registered to vote and others are not. Are you registered to vote in the precinct or election district where you now live, or aren't you?

name: fav bush
question: Is your opinion of George Bush favorable, not favorable, undecided, or haven't you heard enough about George Bush yet to have an opinion?

name: fav clinton
question: Is your opinion of Bill Clinton favorable, not favorable, undecided, or haven't you heard enough about Bill Clinton yet to have an opinion?

name: likely to vote
question: How likely is it that you will vote in the 1992 election for President this November -- would you say you will definitely vote, probably vote, probably not vote, or definitely not vote in the election for President?

name: vote 2way
question: If the 1992 presidential election were being held today, would you vote for George Bush for President and Dan Quayle for Vice-President, the Republican candidates, or for Bill Clinton for President and Al Gore for Vice-President, the Democratic candidates?

name: vote 2way with leaners
question: Well, as of today, do you lean more towards Bush and Quayle, or more towards Clinton and Gore? (column holds q5 choice combined with q5a lean)

name: support strength
question: Would you describe your support for (candidates named) as strongly favoring them, or do you like them but with reservations, or do you support them because you dislike the other candidates?

name: fav perot
question: Is your opinion of Ross Perot favorable, not favorable, undecided, or haven't you heard enough about Ross Perot yet to have an opinion?

name: vote 3way if perot stayed
question: As you may know Ross Perot has decided not to run for President. If Ross Perot had stayed in the race would you have voted for -- George Bush, Bill Clinton, or Ross Perot?

name: perot deserted you
question: (If Perot) Do you feel as if Ross Perot deserted you by leaving the race?

name: campaign attention
question: How much attention have you been able to pay to the 1992 presidential campaign -- a lot, some, not much, or no attention so far?

name: expect to win
question: Regardless of how you intend to vote, who do you expect to finally win the election in November -- George Bush or Bill Clinton?

name: perot right to withdraw
question: Did Ross Perot do the right thing in withdrawing from the race for President, or should he have stayed in?

name: perot accomplished much
question: Do you think Ross Perot accomplished much of what he set out to do in running for President, or did he just walk away before he accomplished much?

name: bush approve
question: Do you approve or disapprove of the way George Bush is handling his job as president?

name: vote88
question: Did you vote for President in 1988, did something prevent you from voting, or did you choose not to vote for President in 1988? If voted: Did you vote for George Bush or Michael Dukakis?
codes: 1=Bush; 2=Dukakis; 3=Voted, won't say for whom or other (vol); 4=Didn't vote; 9=DK/NA

name: talked about campaign
question: In the last week, have you talked about the 1992 Presidential campaign with anyone?

name: party
question: Generally speaking, do you usually consider yourself a Republican, a Democrat, an Independent, or what?

name: party lean
question: Do you think of yourself as closer to the Republican party or to the Democratic party?

name: ideology
question: How would you describe your views on most political matters? Generally do you think of yourself as liberal, moderate, or conservative?

name: religion
question: What is your religious preference today?

name: educ
question: What was the last grade in school you completed?
codes: 1=Not a high school grad; 2=High school grad; 3=Some college (trade or business); 4=College grad and beyond; 9=Refused

name: age
question: How old are you? (18-98 = age, 99 = refused)

name: age group
question: Are you between 18 and 29, 30 and 44, 45 and 64, or are you over 64?

name: race
question: Are you white, Black, or some other race?

name: income
question: Was your total family income in 1991 under or over $30,000? (follow-ups: under or over $15,000; $30-50,000, $50-75,000, or over $75,000)

name: other phone numbers
question: Are there any other telephone numbers in your home that I could have dialed and reached you on -- I don't mean extensions, but different telephone numbers?

name: number of other phones
question: How many other numbers are there in your home? (1-7 = number, 8 = 8 or more, 9 = refused)

name: talkative
question: Interviewer: code whether the respondent was talkative or not talkative or if the first name was refused.
codes: 1=Gave name, talkative; 2=Gave name, not talkative; 3=Refused name

name: census region
question: Census region (derived from telephone number)
